| `$50-$57` | input | `MIA_INPUT_INDEX_KEYBOARD_PROBE_0` | $11000, 1 byte | Keyboard/Keypad bitmap probes. CMD_INPUT_SET_PROBE moves one within the 32-byte bitmap; probes never step. |
| `$58-$5F` | input | `MIA_INPUT_INDEX_CONSUMER_PROBE_0` | $11020, 1 byte | Consumer bitmap probes. CMD_INPUT_SET_PROBE moves one within the 32-byte bitmap; probes never step. |

| `$F0` | kernel | `KIDX_SCROLL_NT_SRC` |  | Scroll DMA source: overlay nametable + 40. The kernel configures it before each use. |
| `$F1` | kernel | `KIDX_SCROLL_NT_DST` |  | Scroll DMA destination: overlay nametable base. The kernel configures it before each use. |
| `$F2` | kernel | `KIDX_SCROLL_ATTR_SRC` |  | Scroll DMA source: overlay attributes + 40. The kernel configures it before each use. |
| `$F3` | kernel | `KIDX_SCROLL_ATTR_DST` |  | Scroll DMA destination: overlay attributes base. The kernel configures it before each use. |
| `$F4` | kernel | `KIDX_MEMORY_SRC` |  | Source for the kernel's MIA memory copy, fill and rectangle services. The kernel configures it before each use. |

Flag bits (`CFG_IDXA_FLAGS`, `CFG_IDXB_FLAGS`):

| Bit | Mask | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `%00000001` | `IDX_FLAG_R_STP_ENA` | Step after the window's data port is read. |
| 1 | `%00000010` | `IDX_FLAG_W_STP_ENA` | Step after the window's data port is written. |
| 2 | `%00000100` | `IDX_FLAG_STP_DIR` | Step direction: 0 forward, 1 backward. |
| 3 | `%00001000` | `IDX_FLAG_WRAP_ENA` | Wrap when the current address crosses the configured range. |
| 4 | `%00010000` | `IDX_FLAG_WRAP_IRQ` | Raise the window's wrap IRQ flag when wrapping. |
